milestone.title: Cut 0.7.0rc1 with the epoch-1 TUI retired
milestone.outcome: The flag day lands: eawf tui opens only the epoch-2 console, drawn to the packet layouts with token paint, settings edit, register-root and bulk select; the epoch-1 TUI and its tests are deleted; flag-day commands refuse epoch-1 state mutation; every shipped lint rule carries its disposition and rendered artifacts are gated; and 0.7.0rc1 is published (decisions D63, D64 and D71).
exclusions: cross-provider, platform and recovery evidence, which rc2 gathers
the perfect-realization gate, which stable runs

acceptance_journey.action: open eawf tui on this repository's epoch-2 tree
acceptance_journey.expected_observation: the console opens and no epoch-1 screen is reachable
the pre-flight passes and 0.7.0rc1 is tagged and observed
